The LED screen displays a black-and-white checkered perspective pattern that gives the illusion of a receding hallway. The performers striking a final, powerful pose as the camera slightly zooms in. The silhouettes of the crowd in the foreground remain static as they observe the high-energy spectacle, with various technical cables and lighting rigs visible in the periphery of the frame.
